name: Debtor
overview: The Scriptures address the condition and treatment of debtors primarily through laws concerning Hebrew servants, who were to serve for six years and be freed in the seventh unless they chose to remain out of love for their master and family. These laws emphasize both the temporary nature of servitude and the dignity of the servant, allowing for voluntary lifelong service under specific circumstances. Additionally, responsibilities related to entrusted property, such as livestock, highlight the accountability expected in dealings involving others' possessions.
